4)	The device as claimed in claim 1, wherein a battery is associated with said device for powering up electrical and electronically operated components associated with said device.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR AN AUTOMATED MASS BALANCE FEEDSTOCK DEMAND
abstract: Disclosed are computer-implemented systems and methods for an automated determination of a mass balance feedstock demand for chemical products produced in a chemical production process of a production plant.
claims:
1. A computer-implemented method for determining an input material demand for two or more chemical products produced in a chemical production process of a production plant comprising:

receiving input material data associated with one or more input materials to the chemical production process;

receiving process data for one or more process steps in the chemical production process;

receiving consumption data indicating an amount of feedstock associated with producing two or more chemical products;

identifying based on the process data at least one process step producing from the one or more input materials two or more chemical products, wherein the two or more chemical products includes a first chemical product and a second chemical product; determining based, at least in part, on a mass allocation calculation a mass fraction feedstock demand for the first chemical product;

determining based, at least in part, on a stoichiometric allocation calculation a stoichiometric-based feedstock demand for the first chemical product; comparing the mass fraction feedstock demand for the first chemical product with the stoichiometric-based feedstock demand for the first chemical product to determine a deviation value for the first chemical product;

determining if the deviation value for the first chemical product exceeds a target value;

determining based, at least in part, on steering logic a substituted feedstock demand for the first chemical product, if the deviation value for the first chemical product exceeds the target value;

calculating a feedstock demand for the second chemical product based, at least in part, on the substituted feedstock demand for the first chemical product and the consumption data; and

outputting the substituted feedstock demand for the first chemical product and the feedstock demand for the second chemical product.

2. The computer-implemented method of claim 1 , wherein determining based, at least in part, on steering logic the substituted feedstock demand for the first chemical product, if the deviation value for the first chemical product exceeds the target value further comprises:

determining if the steering logic includes dedicated production data associated with the first chemical product; and

selecting the substituted feedstock demand for the first chemical product based, at least in part, on the dedicated production data associated with the first chemical product, if the steering logic includes dedicated production data associated with the first chemical product.

3. The computer-implemented method of claim 2, wherein determining based, at least in part, on steering logic the substituted feedstock demand for the first chemical product, if the deviation value for the first chemical product exceeds the target value further comprises:

if the steering logic does not include dedicated production data associated with the first chemical product, determining if the steering logic includes externally sourced production data associated with the first chemical product; and

selecting the substituted feedstock demand for the first chemical product based, at least in part, on the externally sourced production data associated with the first chemical product, if the steering logic includes externally sourced production data associated with the first chemical product.

4. The computer-implemented method of claim 3, wherein determining based, at least in part, on steering logic the substituted feedstock demand for the first chemical product, if the deviation value for the first chemical product exceeds the target value further comprises:

if the steering logic does not include externally sourced production data associated with the first chemical product, determining an input factor associated with the first chemical product; and

selecting the substituted feedstock demand for the first chemical product based, at least in part, on the input factor associated with the first chemical product.

5. The computer-implemented method according to any of the claims 1 to 4, wherein determining based, at least in part, on steering logic the substituted feedstock demand for the first chemical product, if the deviation value for the first chemical product exceeds the target value further comprises determining whether to apply a correction factor to the substituted feedstock demand for the first chemical product based, at least in part on the steering logic.

6. The computer-implemented method according to any of the claims 1 to 5, wherein selecting the substituted feedstock demand for the first chemical product comprises selecting a substituted sustainable feedstock demand for the first chemical product.

7. The computer-implemented method according to any of the claims 1 to 6, wherein calculating the feedstock demand for the second chemical product based, at least in part, on the substituted feedstock demand for the first chemical product comprises selecting a substituted sustainable feedstock demand for the second chemical product based, at least in part, on the substituted feedstock demand for the first chemical product.

8. The computer-implemented method according to any of the claims 1 to 7, further comprising:

determining if the first chemical product and/or the second chemical product contain hydrogen with a mass share above a threshold value; and

determining based, at least in part, on an energy content allocation calculation an energy content feedstock demand for the first chemical product, if the first chemical product and/or the second chemical product contain hydrogen with a mass share above the threshold value.

9. A non-transitory computer readable data medium storing a computer program including instructions for executing steps of the method according to any of the preceding claims.

10. A system for determining an input material demand for two or more chemical products produced in a chemical production process of a production plant comprising:

an input configured to receive (i) input material data associated with one or more input materials to the chemical production process and (ii) process data for one or more process steps in the chemical production process;

a processor configured to (i) identify based on the process data at least one process step producing from the one or more input materials two or more chemical output products, wherein the two or more chemical products includes a first chemical product and a second chemical product (ii) determine based, at least in part, on a mass allocation calculation a mass fraction feedstock demand for the first chemical product (iii) determine based, at least in part, on a stoichiometric allocation calculation a stoichiometric-based feedstock demand for the first chemical product (iv) compare the mass fraction feedstock demand for the first chemical product with the stoichiometric-based feedstock demand for the first chemical product to determine a deviation value for the first chemical product (v) determine if the deviation value for the first chemical product exceeds a target value (vi) determine based, at least in part, on steering logic a substituted feedstock demand for the first chemical product, if the deviation value for the first chemical product exceeds the target value and (vii) calculate a feedstock demand for the second chemical product based, at least in part, on the substituted feedstock demand for the first chemical product; and

an output configured to output the substituted feedstock demand for the first chemical product and the feedstock demand for the second chemical product.

11. The system according to claim 10, wherein the input comprises an interface to a consolidation system which collects data from different production plant(s), wherein the consolidation system consolidates the process data to identify intermediates produced by different production plants.

12. The system according to any of the claims 10-11 , wherein the output comprises a user interface configured to display the substituted feedstock demand for the first chemical product and the feedstock demand for the second chemical product.

13. The system according to any of the claims 10-12, wherein the processor configured to determine based, at least in part, on steering logic a substituted feedstock demand for the first chemical product, if the deviation value for the first chemical product exceeds the target value further comprises a processor to:

determine if the steering logic includes dedicated production data associated with the first chemical product; and

select the substituted feedstock demand for the first chemical product based, at least in part, on the dedicated production data associated with the first chemical product, if the steering logic includes dedicated production data associated with the first chemical product.

14. The system according to any of the claims 10-13, wherein the processor configured to determine based, at least in part, on steering logic a substituted feedstock demand for the first chemical product, if the deviation value for the first chemical product exceeds the target value further comprises a processor to:

if the steering logic does not include dedicated production data associated with the first chemical product, determine if the steering logic includes externally sourced production data associated with the first chemical product; and

select the substituted feedstock demand for the first chemical product based, at least in part, on the externally sourced production data associated with the first chemical product, if the steering logic includes externally sourced production data associated with the first chemical product.

15. The system according to any of the claims 10-14, wherein the processor configured to determine based, at least in part, on steering logic a substituted feedstock demand for the first chemical product, if the deviation value for the first chemical product exceeds the target value further comprises a processor to:

- if the steering logic does not include externally sourced production data associated with the first chemical product, determine an input factor associated with the first chemical product; and

select the substituted feedstock demand for the first chemical product based, at least in part, on the input factor associated with the first chemical product.

title: MODULAR DOOR FOR PET ANIMAL
abstract: A modular door for pet animal comprises of an expandable frame 101 positioned in an opening craved on a door panel, a user-interface installed in a computing unit wirelessly associated with door for user input to secure frame 101 in opening, a laser measurement sensor installed on frame 101 to detect dimension of opening, a motorized drawer arrangement 102 integrated in frame 101 to adjust dimension of frame 101, multiple suction units 103 installed on frame 101 to secure frame 101 in opening, two motorized hinge 105 joint developed to allow a pet animal to enter/exit door, a thermal camera 106 installed on each side of frame 101 to detect approaching of any pet animal along with monitoring distance of pet animal, an imaging unit 107 for authenticating the pet animal, an air blower 108 installed on frame 101 to blow dirt away from pet animal’s body.
specification:
FIELD OF THE INVENTION

[0001]	The present invention relates to a modular door for pet animal that is capable of providing an entry/exit facility for pet animals into an enclosure, equipped with authentication mechanism to prevent unauthorized animals from entering, along with a blowing mechanism to keep dirt out during the pet’s entry.

BACKGROUND OF THE INVENTION
	
[0002]	 Pet owners often face challenges in providing their pets with easy access to outdoor and indoor spaces while ensuring security and cleanliness. Common issues include unauthorized animals entering, difficulty in installation due to size constraints, and pets bringing in dirt. Additionally, scratching can cause damage over time. A smart and adaptable solution can enhance convenience, improve security, and maintain hygiene, creating a better experience for both pets and owners.

[0003]	 Traditional pet doors are simple openings that allow pets to pass through freely. However, they often lack security features, making it easy for stray animals to enter. Some models include basic locks, but they require manual operation and do not distinguish between pets. These doors also pose installation challenges due to fixed dimensions and do not address concerns like dirt accumulation or damage from scratching, leading to frequent maintenance.

[0004]	US5269097A discloses a modular pet access door unit for insertion into a hole cut into a door or wall has exterior frames and spacer frames, fastened together by fasteners extending horizontally through brackets in the spacer frames. The spacer frames have tongue and groove surfaces for nesting with each other. Both exterior frames may carry a pet access door. A security cover mounts on posts with annular grooves, and may be moved horizontally into position to cover the pet opening, where sliders in the security cover with keyhole-shaped holes engage the post annular grooves. The pet door is captured in the frame between the frame and a door or flap holder that is secured to the frame by removably fasteners. An automatically adjustable sill is movable by magnetic attraction to the flap bottom, where its position is secured by fasteners.

[0005]	US6141911A discloses a pet door having a pair of bolt assemblies with bolts mounted in a frame having an aperture in which a door flap is pivotably mounted. The bolts are extendable into the door flap and retractable into the frame to lock and unlock the pet door, respectively. A bolt mechanism controller is arranged to unlock the pet door on detection of a pet carrying the correct key transmitter and to relock the pet door a user adjustable predetermined time after unlocking the pet door. This provides a pet door which can be used to automatically permit entry to a selected pet while using a robust bolt of especial application to larger pet doors such as dog doors.

[0006]	Conventionally, many doors have been developed pet door, however the doors mentioned in the prior arts have limitations pertaining to automated entry/exit door, taking care of cleaning of the pet, unauthorized entry of stray animals.

[0007]	In order to overcome the aforementioned drawbacks, there exists a need in the art to develop a door that requires to be capable of providing a facility for entry/exit of pet animal into an enclosure with authentication feature to prevent unauthorized entry of stray animals, along with a blowing mechanism to restrict dirt entry into the enclosure during the entry of the pet animal.

 OBJECTS OF THE INVENTION

[0008]	 The principal object of the present invention is to overcome the disadvantages of the prior art.

[0009]	An object of the present invention is to develop a door that is capable of providing an entry/exit door for pet animal provisioned to get accommodated in an opening craved on a door panel of an enclosure.

[0010]	Another object of the present invention is to develop a door that is capable of authenticating pet animal for allowing entry inside the door, in view of preventing entry of stray animals.

[0011]	Yet another object of the present invention is to develop a door that is capable of blowing dirt away from the pet animal’s body during the pet animal’s entry to restrict eliminate dirt into the enclosure.
    	
[0012]	 The foregoing and other objects, features, and advantages of the present invention will become readily apparent upon further review of the following detailed description of the preferred embodiment as illustrated in the accompanying drawings.

SUMMARY OF THE INVENTION

[0013]	 The present invention relates to a modular door for pet animal that is capable of  enabling a secure entry and exit for pet animals into an enclosure, with an authentication feature to block stray animals, and a blowing mechanism to prevent dirt from entering during the pet animal's access.

[0014]	 According to an embodiment of the present invention, a modular door for pet animal comprises of an expandable frame positioned in an opening craved on a door panel, a user-interface installed in a computing unit wirelessly associated with the door that is accessed by the user to provide input command to secure the frame in the opening, a laser measurement sensor installed on the frame to detect dimension of the opening, a motorized drawer arrangement integrated in the frame to adjust dimension of the frame corresponding to dimension of the opening, plurality of suction units installed on the frame to secure the frame in the opening, a motorized flap installed in the frame by means of a pair of motorized hinge joint developed to allow a pet animal to enter/exit the door, a thermal camera installed on each side of the frame and each synced with an ultrasonic sensor to detect approaching of any pet animal towards the door along with monitoring distance of the pet animal, an artificial intelligence based imaging unit integrated with a processer installed on each side of the frame for capturing and comparing images of the pet animal with pre-stored images, an air blower installed on the frame to blow air on the pet animal’s body during entry/exit in order to blow dirt away from the pet animal’s body.

[0015]	According to another embodiment of the present invention, the proposed door further comprises of an anti-scratch sheet is configured on each side of the frame to provide a designated space for the pet animal to scratch nails for preventing damage to the door, and a battery is associated with the door for supplying power to electrical and electronically operated components associated with the door.

[0016]	 While the invention has been described and shown with particular reference to the preferred embodiment, it will be apparent that variations might be possible that would fall within the scope of the present invention.

BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF THE DRAWINGS 

[0017]	 These and other features, aspects, and advantages of the present invention will become better understood with regard to the following description, appended claims, and accompanying drawings where:
Figure 1 illustrates an isometric view of a modular door for pet animal.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION OF THE INVENTION 

[0018]	 The following description includes the preferred best mode of one embodiment of the present invention. It will be clear from this description of the invention that the invention is not limited to these illustrated embodiments but that the invention also includes a variety of modifications and embodiments thereto. Therefore, the present description should be seen as illustrative and not limiting. While the invention is susceptible to various modifications and alternative constructions, it should be understood, that there is no intention to limit the invention to the specific form disclosed, but, on the contrary, the invention is to cover all modifications, alternative constructions, and equivalents falling within the spirit and scope of the invention as defined in the claims.

[0019]	 In any embodiment described herein, the open-ended terms "comprising," "comprises,” and the like (which are synonymous with "including," "having” and "characterized by") may be replaced by the respective partially closed phrases "consisting essentially of," consists essentially of," and the like or the respective closed phrases "consisting of," "consists of, the like.

[0020]	 As used herein, the singular forms “a,” “an,” and “the” designate both the singular and the plural, unless expressly stated to designate the singular only. 	

[0021]	The present invention relates to a modular pet door that is capable of providing a secure access of entry/exit for pet animal into an enclosure, featuring an authentication mechanism to prevent unauthorized entry/exit of stray animals, along with a blowing mechanism to restrict any dirt entrance into the enclosure during the entry of the pet animal.

[0022]	 Referring to Figure 1, an isometric view of a modular door for pet animal is illustrated, comprising an expandable frame 101 having a motorized drawer arrangement 102, plurality of suction units 103 installed on the frame 101, a motorized flap 104 installed in the frame 101 by means of a pair of motorized hinge 105 joint, a thermal camera 106 installed on each side of the frame 101, an artificial intelligence based imaging unit 107 installed on each side of the frame 101, an air blower 108 installed on the frame 101, and an anti-scratch sheet 109 configured on each side of the frame 101.  

[0023]	 The proposed invention includes an expandable frame 101 incorporating various components associated with the door. The frame 101 is developed to be positioned in an opening craved on a door panel by a user. The frame 101 is made up of any material selected from but not limited to metal or alloy that ensures rigidity of the frame 101 for longevity of the door.

[0024]	 The user is required to access and presses a push button arranged on the frame 101 to activate the door for associated processes of the door. The push button when pressed by the user, closes an electrical circuit and allows currents to flow for powering an associated microcontroller of the door for operating of all the linked components for performing their respective functions upon actuation.

[0025]	 The microcontroller, mentioned herein, is preferably an Arduino microcontroller. The Arduino microcontroller used herein controls the overall functionality of the components linked to it. The Arduino microcontroller is an open-source programming platform.

[0026]	 After the activation of the door, the user accesses a user interface which is inbuilt in a computing unit linked with the microcontroller wirelessly by means of a communication module. The user interface enables the user to provide input regarding to secure the frame 101 in the opening. The communication module includes, but not limited to Wi-Fi (Wireless Fidelity) module, Bluetooth module, GSM (Global System for Mobile Communication) module. The Wi-Fi module contains transmitters and receivers that use radio frequency signals to transmit data wirelessly to the microcontroller. The wireless module typically includes components such as antennas, amplifiers, and processors to facilitate communication and further connected to networks such as Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, or cellular networks, allowing doors to exchange information over short or long distances.

[0027]	In accordance to the user’s input, the dimensions of the door opening is measured by a laser measurement sensor installed on the frame 101. The laser measurement sensor, used herein, is a measurement value recorder working with laser technology and turning the physical measured value into an analog electric signal. The laser measurement sensor is conceived for contactless measurement which is based on the triangulation principle. Triangulation used for determining measurement by angle calculation where the sensor projects a laser spot on the door opening. The reflected light falls incident onto a receiving unit at a certain angle depending on the distance and these received lights are converted into signals and sent to the microcontroller. The microcontroller then processes the received signals in order to monitor the dimensions of the door opening.

[0028]	As per the detected dimensions of the opening, the microcontroller actuates a motorized drawer arrangement 102 integrated in the frame 101 for adjusting the size of the frame 101. The drawer arrangement 102 consists of a motor, hollow compartment and multiple compartments that are connected with sliders. After actuating by the microcontroller, an electric current pass through the motor of the drawer mechanism and energized the motor. The energized motor further actuates the compartments which are initially at the stowed condition to move in a successive manner within the hollow compartment and extends length of the compartments. Simultaneously, each of the compartments having a fixed groove track, wherein upon actuation of the slider, the motor of the slider gets energized and provides a movement to the compartment to move in a linear direction on the groove track of the successive compartment as directed by the microcontroller and extends length of the frame 101 corresponding to dimension of the opening, to install the frame 101 in the opening.

[0029]	The frame 101 is installed with multiple suction units 103 and that are actuated by the microcontroller to secure the frame 101 in the opening. Each of the suction unit works by atmospheric pressure such that when the piston is raised, creating a partial vacuum, atmospheric pressure outside forces air into the cylinder, whence it is permitted to escape by an outlet valve. The suction cup is supplied with a motor that creates a vacuum continuously and holds the frame 101 with the opening tightly. The suction units 103 enable the frame 101 to get adhered with the edges of the opening with the opening.

[0030]	The frame 101 is arranged with a motorized flap 104 by means of a pair of motorized hinge 105 joint. The microcontroller powers a direct current (DC) motor associated with the hinge 105 joint as per requirement such that tilt the flap 104 by revolving along the longitudinal axis. The tilting of the flap 104 results in allowing a pet animal to enter/exit the door.

[0031]	Each side of the frame 101 is installed with a thermal camera 106 synced with an ultrasonic sensor. The thermal camera 106 starts detecting infrared energy of any living animal in proximity to the frame 101. After detecting of the energy, the microcontroller starts processing the energy in the form of infrared data and after that the thermal camera 106 starts converting that infrared data into digital signals. After that the data is transmitted to the microcontroller, where it analyzes the data to detect presence of any living animal in the proximity of the frame 101.

[0032]	The ultrasonic sensor disclosed herein, consists of an emitter and a receiver that acts as a transducer. The emitter emits ultrasonic sound waves towards pet animal. Then, the radiation strike to the pet animal and reflect back which are captured by the receiver. The signal is sent to the microcontroller. The microcontroller processes the received signal from the ultrasonic sensor and on the basis of time lapse in between the sent and received radiations, the signal is sent to the microcontroller for processing. The microcontroller analyzes the collected data of the thermal camera 106 and the ultrasonic sensors to determine presence of any approaching pet animal towards the door along with monitoring distance of the pet animal.

[0033]	In case the microcontroller evaluates the detected distance recedes a threshold limit, the microcontroller activates an artificial intelligence based imaging unit 107 integrated with a processer, installed on each side of the frame 101 for capturing and comparing images of the pet animal with pre-stored images in a linked database, for authenticating the pet animal.

[0034]	In case the microcontroller via the imaging unit 107 evaluates successful authentication of the pet animal, the microcontroller actuates the hinge 105 joint to provide angular movement to the flap 104, in view of allowing the pet animal to enter/exist the door.

[0035]	 In case the microcontroller via the imaging unit 107 evaluates unsuccessful authentication of the pet animal, indicating presence of stray animal near the door. The microcontroller sends an alert on the computing unit, to notify the user to take necessary action. 

[0036]	During entry/exit of the pet animal, the microcontroller actuates an air blower 108 installed over the frame 101 to blow air on the pet animal’s body. The air blower 108 works by increasing velocity of air when the air is passed through equipped impellers, thereby blows a stream of concentrated air towards the pet animal, in order to blow dirt away from the pet animal’s body.

[0037]	In addition, each side of the frame 101 is arranged with an anti-scratch sheet 109 to provide a designated space for the pet animal to scratch nails, preventing damage to the door, thereby preventing the door from unwanted scratching.

[0038]	A battery (not shown in figure) is associated with the door to supply power to electrically powered components which are employed herein. The battery is comprised of a pair of electrodes named as a cathode and an anode. The battery uses a chemical reaction of oxidation/reduction to do work on charge and produce a voltage between their anode and cathode and thus produces electrical energy that is used to do work in the door.

[0039]	The present invention works best in the following manner, where the proposed invention includes securing of the expandable frame 101 within the opening of the door panel, operated by the user via the wireless user-interface on the computing unit. Upon receiving the user’s input, the microcontroller activates the laser measurement sensor to detect the dimensions of the opening, then adjusts the frame’s size using the motorized drawer arrangement 102 to fit the opening. suction units 103 on the frame 101 adhere to the edges of the opening to secure the frame 101 in place. The motorized flap 104, connected via hinge 105 joints, allows the pet animal to pass through. Thermal camera 106 and ultrasonic sensors monitor the pet animal’s approach and distance, and if the pet animal is detected within the threshold range, the microcontroller authenticates the pet animal by comparing images with the database. Upon successful authentication, the flap 104 opens, and the air blower 108 is activated to clean the pet animal as it passes. In the case of unsuccessful authentication, indicating the presence of the stray animal, the microcontroller sends the alert to the user. The frame 101 also features the anti-scratch sheet 109 on each side to prevent damage to the door from the pet animal’s scratching.

[0040]	 Although the field of the invention has been described herein with limited reference to specific embodiments, this description is not meant to be construed in a limiting sense. Various modifications of the disclosed embodiments, as well as alternate embodiments of the invention, will become apparent to persons skilled in the art upon reference to the description of the invention.  ,

title: HANDHELD NAIL INSERTION AND REMOVAL ASSISTIVE DEVICE
abstract: A handheld nail insertion and removal assistive device, comprising cylindrical body 101 attached with handle 102 gripped by user for positioning body’s 101 mouth portion near drilled slot on a fixed surface, imaging unit 103 integrated in body 101 determine dimensions of slot, bar 104 arranged on body 101 and configured with multiple nails 105 via electromagnet 106 arranged on bar 104, motorized clipper 107 installed on mouth portion grip appropriate nail, motorized slider 108 integrated between clippers 107 and bar 104 position nail near mouth portion of body 101, telescopically operated rod 109 integrated between body 101 and clipper 107 allow clipper 107 to engage gripped nail into slot, plate 110 arranged on mouth portion via linear actuator 111 for positioning plate 110 onto engaged nail and providing tapping movement to plate 110 on nail for hammering nail into slot, thereby assisting user in insertion of nail into slot.
specification:
FIELD OF THE INVENTION

[0001]	The present invention relates to a handheld nail insertion and removal assistive device that provide a hand-held means to a user to insert and remove nails into/ from a drilled cavity over a fixed surface in a self-sufficient manner by gripping a suitable nail as per the dimension of the cavity and also absorbs any shock and vibration produced during nail insertion or removal process.

BACKGROUND OF THE INVENTION
	
[0002]	 Nails are typically driven into the workpiece by a hammer or nail gun. A nail holds materials together by friction in the axial direction and shear strength. Nail installation and extraction device, often referred to as a nailer, is a power tool designed for efficiently driving nails into various materials and extracting them when necessary. These devices have significantly revolutionized the construction, woodworking, and carpentry industries. Traditionally hammers were used for nail extractions usually made of metal, attached to a handle. The head typically has two striking surfaces a flat one for driving the nail and a claw for extracting nails.

[0003]	 Major drawbacks faced by the traditional nail extraction and installation devices are hhammering nails manually was a slower process compared to modern nail guns, as each nail had to be individually driven into the material. It required significant physical effort and could lead to injuries also achieving consistent angle for nails was challenging requires skill and experience. Thus, the challenge is to make a device that is capable of providing a virtual; assistance to a user to insert a nail on a fixed surface and also assist the user to remove the nail installed on the surface in an automated manner as per the requirement of the user.

[0004]	CN203235870U provides an iron nail repairing device which comprises a face plate, wherein an iron nail placing position is arranged on the face plate, the left front position, the left rear position, the right front position and the right rear position of the iron nail placing position are respectively provided with a sliding groove, and a clamping plate which is connected with a motor is arranged in each sliding groove. According to the iron nail repairing device, waste and old iron nails can be conveniently and efficiently repaired, the nails can be utilized repeatedly, construction cost is greatly reduced, and meanwhile construction waste and environmental pollution are prevented.

[0005]	US6695288B2 discloses a pneumatic nail puller tool for use with a standard needle scaler actuator. A needle scaler typically actuates a chipping hammer installed by means of a chuck. The nail puller tool is so sized and configured as to replace the chipping hammer and lock into its chuck. The nail puller, so installed, is useful in quickly removing nails from a work piece, even where a nail head is buried in the work piece. The nail puller includes a central shaft having a shank having flats and a detent seat for locking into the needle scaler chuck at one end and a nail removing claw at the opposing end. The claw is angled relative to the shaft to provide a lever point to assist in extracting the nail. The claw has sharp entrance points for digging into the work piece to grip an embedded nail head.
	
[0006]	Conventionally, many devices exist that are capable of assisting a user in extraction and installation of nails. However, these devices are incapable of pulling the nails in a self-sufficient manner by applying an optimum force, and fails in reducing the manual efforts as well as consumption of time in the overall process. Additionally, the existing devices also lacks in absorbing impact experienced by the user during insertion and extraction of the nail.

[0007]	In order to overcome the aforementioned drawbacks, there exists a need in the art to develop a device that is capable of assisting a user in extracting and inserting nails from/ into drilled cavity over a fixed surface by securely gripping and pulling /pushing the nail in a self-sufficient manner. In addition, the developed device also provide a secure grip over the user’s hand by detecting the presence of moisture over the user’s hand to prevent any accidental slip.

 OBJECTS OF THE INVENTION

[0008]	 The principal object of the present invention is to overcome the disadvantages of the prior art.

[0009]	 An object of the present invention is to develop a device that is assist a user in insertion and removal of nail into or from a drilled slot on a fixed surface in an easy and secured manner, thereby reducing manual effort required in insertion and removal of nails.

[0010]	Another object of the present invention is to develop a device that is capable of detecting shocks and vibrations caused during insertion of the nail and accordingly provide a means for absorbing the shocks, thus ensuring stability of the device, enhancing user comfort, and preventing damage to the surrounding surface.

[0011]	 Yet another object of the present invention is to develop a device that is capable of detecting presence of moisture onto the user’s hand while performing insertion or removal of nail and accordingly provide a means for securely gripping the user’s hand, thereby ensuring a firm hold, preventing accidental slips, and enhancing operational safety during use. 
    	
[0012]	 The foregoing and other objects, features, and advantages of the present invention will become readily apparent upon further review of the following detailed description of the preferred embodiment as illustrated in the accompanying drawings.

SUMMARY OF THE INVENTION

[0013]	 The present invention relates to a handheld nail insertion and removal assistive device that is capable of inserting nails into the drilled cavity over a fixed surface in an automated manner by gripping the suitable nail as per the dimension of the cavity. Further, the device is capable of providing a secure grip over the user’s hand while holding the device to prevent accidental slip.

[0014]	According to an embodiment of the present invention, a handheld nail insertion and removal assistive device comprises of a cylindrical body attached with a handle that is gripped by a user for positioning the body’s mouth portion in proximity to a drilled slot on a fixed surface, a user interface installed on a computing unit for enabling the user to provide input specifications regarding inserting nails into the slots for a user-desired purpose, an artificial intelligence-based imaging unit integrated in the body and paired with a processor to determine dimensions of the slot, a bar arranged on the body and configured with multiple nails, each adhered on the bar by means of an electromagnet arranged on the bar, a motorized clipper installed on the mouth portion to acquire a grip of the appropriate nail, a motorized slider integrated in between the clippers and bar to provide required translation to the clipper for positioning the appropriate nail in proximity to mouth portion of the body, a telescopically operated rod integrated in between the body and clipper for extending to allow the clipper to engage the gripped nail into the slot, a plate arranged on the mouth portion by means of a linear actuator for positioning the plate onto the engaged nail and provide reciprocating back and forth movement to apply an optimum force onto the plate for providing tapping movement to the plate on the nail in view of hammering the nail into the slot, thereby assisting the user in insertion of the nail into the slot, as per requirement.

[0015]	According to another embodiment of the present invention, the proposed device further comprises of a motorized ball and socket joint is integrated in between the clipper and rod for providing required movement to the clipper in view of properly gripping and engaging the nail, an impact sensor is embedded in the body for detecting shocks and vibrations caused during the hammering, an electromagnetic spring installed in between the handle and body for expanding/contracting to dampen the shocks/vibrations, a moisture sensor is embedded in the handle for detecting presence of moisture onto the handle, an expandable strap to wrap over the user’s wrist for gripping the user’s hand for securing the user’s hands on the body, in case the user-desired operation corresponds to removal of the nail, plurality of motorized hinges integrated within the plate to acquire a shape of the nail, a motorized circular slider integrated in between the body and plate for providing rotational movement to the plate in view of unfastening the nail from the slot, and a battery is configured with the device for providing a continuous power supply to electronically powered components associated with the device.

[0016]	 While the invention has been described and shown with particular reference to the preferred embodiment, it will be apparent that variations might be possible that would fall within the scope of the present invention.

BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF THE DRAWINGS 

[0017]	 These and other features, aspects, and advantages of the present invention will become better understood with regard to the following description, appended claims, and accompanying drawings where:
Figure 1 illustrates an isometric view of a handheld nail insertion and removal assistive device.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION OF THE INVENTION 

[0018]	 The following description includes the preferred best mode of one embodiment of the present invention. It will be clear from this description of the invention that the invention is not limited to these illustrated embodiments but that the invention also includes a variety of modifications and embodiments thereto. Therefore, the present description should be seen as illustrative and not limiting. While the invention is susceptible to various modifications and alternative constructions, it should be understood, that there is no intention to limit the invention to the specific form disclosed, but, on the contrary, the invention is to cover all modifications, alternative constructions, and equivalents falling within the spirit and scope of the invention as defined in the claims.

[0019]	 In any embodiment described herein, the open-ended terms "comprising," "comprises,” and the like (which are synonymous with "including," "having” and "characterized by") may be replaced by the respective partially closed phrases "consisting essentially of," consists essentially of," and the like or the respective closed phrases "consisting of," "consists of,  the like.

[0020]	 As used herein, the singular forms “a,” “an,” and “the” designate both the singular and the plural, unless expressly stated to designate the singular only. 	

[0021]	The present invention relates to a handheld nail insertion and removal assistive device that aids a user in easy and effective insertion and removal of nails over the drilled cavity of a fixed surface. Additionally, the proposed device is also capable of detecting shocks and vibrations caused during insertion of the nail and absorb the shocks in order to enhance user comfort.

[0022]	 Referring to Figure 1, an isometric view of a handheld nail insertion and removal assistive device is illustrated, comprising a cylindrical body 101 attached with a handle 102, an artificial intelligence-based imaging unit 103 integrated in the body 101, a bar 104 arranged on the body 101 and configured with multiple nails 105, an electromagnet 106 arranged on the bar 104, a motorized clipper 107 installed on the mouth portion of the body 101, a motorized slider 108 integrated in between the clippers 107 and bar 104, a telescopically operated rod 109 integrated in between the body 101 and clipper 107, a plate 110 arranged on the mouth portion by means of a linear actuator 111, an expandable strap 112 configured with the handle 102, plurality of motorized hinges 113 integrated within the plate 110, and a motorized circular slider 114 integrated in between the body 101 and plate 110.

[0023]	 The device disclosed herein comprises of a cylindrical body 101 incorporating various components associated with the device. The body 101 serves as the core structure and is made up of lightweight and durable material that includes but not limited to reinforced plastic or metal that offer strength and rigidity to the body 101, making it resistant to mechanical stress and pressure. Vibration-dampening materials are integrated into the body 101 to minimize noise and shaking of the body 101 during operations in order to enhance device longevity and provide comfort to a user.

[0024]	 A handle 102 is attached with the body 101 that is gripped by a user to position the mouth portion of the body 101 in proximity to a drilled slot on a fixed surface in to which nail is to be inserted or removed. Upon positioning the mouth portion in proximity to the drilled slot, the user is required to access a user-interface inbuilt in a computing unit (such as a smartphone, tablet, or other handheld devices) wirelessly linked with an inbuilt microcontroller associated with the device to give input specifications regarding inserting nails 105 into the slots for a user-desired purpose. The computing unit is wirelessly associated with the microcontroller via a communication module which includes, but not limited to Wi-Fi (Wireless Fidelity) module, Bluetooth module, GSM (Global System for Mobile Communication) module.

[0025]	 The communication module allows the microcontroller to send and receive data to and from the computing unit without the need for physical connections. The Wi-Fi module provides connectivity over local networks, enabling real-time communication over longer distances. The Bluetooth module offers short-range, low-power communication, ideal for close proximity. The GSM module allows for communication over mobile networks, facilitating remote monitoring and control from virtually anywhere. This versatile connectivity ensures seamless interaction between the microcontroller and the computing unit for enabling the user to remotely give specifications regarding inserting nails 105 into the slots.

[0026]	 The microcontroller processes the input details and accordingly actuates an artificial intelligence-based imaging unit 103 integrated in the body 101 and paired with a processor for capturing and processing multiple images in vicinity of the body 101, respectively. The imaging unit 103 comprises of a high-resolution camera lens, digital camera sensor and a processor, wherein the lens captures multiple images from different angles and perspectives in vicinity of the body 101 with the help of digital camera sensor for providing comprehensive coverage of the slot.

[0027]	 The captured images then go through pre-processing steps by the processor integrated with the imaging unit 103. The processor carries out a sequence of image processing operation including pre-processing, feature extraction and classification in order to enhance the image quality, which includes adjusting brightness and contrast and removing any distortion or noise. The pre-processed images are transmitted to the microcontroller linked with the processor in the form of electrical signals.

[0028]	 The signals are then processed by the microcontroller to determine dimensions of the slot, based on which the microcontroller detects suitability of the slot, along with evaluates an appropriate nail to be inserted in the slot. A bar 104 is arranged on the body 101 and configured with multiple nails 105, each adhered on the bar 104 by means of an electromagnet 106 arranged on the bar 104. 

[0029]	Based on the evaluated nail, the microcontroller actuates a motorized clipper 107 installed on the mouth portion to acquire a grip of the appropriate nail. The motorized clipper 107 is operated by a pair of jaws or clamping arms which are alternately squeezed together and released for gripping or releasing the nail and is driven by a motor which makes the jaws or clamping arms to oscillate from side to side. Upon actuation of the motorized clipper 107 by the microcontroller, the motor rotates the jaws to oscillate and acquire a grip of the appropriate nail.

[0030]	 Once the nail is gripped by the clipper 107, the microcontroller de-energizes the electromagnet 106 for disengaging the nail from the bar 104. The electromagnet 106 used herein consist of a coil of wire wrapped around a core of ferromagnetic material, such as iron. On actuation by the microcontroller, an electric current flows through the coil, that generates a magnetic field around the coil, which magnetize/ de-magnetize the core of the electromagnet 106 for engaging/ disengaging the nail.

[0031]	 Once the nail is disengaged, the microcontroller actuates a motorized slider 108 integrated in between the clippers 107 and bar 104 to provide required translation to the clipper 107 for positioning the appropriate nail in proximity to mouth portion of the body 101. The slider 108 used herein consists of a sliding-rail and multiple rolling members which are integrated with a step motor. On actuation, the step motor rotates the rolling members in order to provide rolling motion to the members which results in sliding of the members and provide required translation to the clipper 107 for positioning the appropriate nail in proximity to mouth portion of the body 101.

[0032]	 Post positioning of the nail, the microcontroller actuates a telescopically operated rod 109 integrated in between the body 101 and clipper 107 for extending to allow the clipper 107 to engage the gripped nail into the slot. The extension/retraction of the rod 109 is powered by a pneumatic unit associated with device that includes an air compressor, air cylinder, air valves and piston which works in collaboration to aid in extension/retraction of the rod 109.

[0033]	The air compressor used herein extract the air from surrounding and increases the pressure of the air by reducing the volume of the air. The air compressor is consisting of two main parts including a motor and a pump. The motor powers the compressor pump which uses the energy from the motor drive to draw in atmospheric air and compress to elevated pressure. The compressed air is then sent through a discharge tube into the cylinder across the valve. The compressed air in the cylinder tends to pushes out the piston to extend. The piston is attached to the rod 109, wherein the extension/retraction of the piston corresponds to the extension/retraction of the rod 109 in order to allow the clipper 107 to engage the gripped nail into the slot.

[0034]	 Simultaneously, the microcontroller actuates a motorized ball and socket joint integrated in between the clipper 107 and rod 109 for providing required movement to the clipper 107. The motorized ball-and-socket joint used herein is a mechanical component that connects the clipper 107 to the rod 109. The ball-and-socket joint permits rotational and tilting movements, enabling the clipper 107 to rotate on its axis.
 
[0035]	 The ball and socket joint is a coupling consisting of a ball joint securely locked within a socket joint, where the ball joint is able to move in a 360-dgree rotation within the socket thus, providing the required movement to the clipper 107. The ball and socket joint is powered by a DC (direct current) motor that is actuated by the microcontroller for providing required movement to the clipper 107, in view of properly gripping and engaging the nail into the slot.

[0036]	 A plate 110 is arranged on the mouth portion by means of a linear actuator 111, wherein after the nail is inserted into the slot, the microcontroller actuates the linear actuator 111 for positioning the plate 110 onto the engaged nail and providing reciprocating back and forth movement to the plate 110 in order to deliver tapping force onto the nail. 

[0037]	The linear actuator 111 comprises of a motor, a lead screw and a nut. When actuated by the microcontroller, the motor generates rotational force, which is then converted into linear motion through the interaction between the lead screw and the nut. The lead screw, driven by the motor, turns and causes the nut to move along its threads. This movement pushes or pulls the connected chain, exerting pushing/pulling pressure on the plate 110. As the actuator 111 extends/ retracts, it applies the necessary force onto the plate 110, for providing tapping movement to the plate 110 on the nail, in view of hammering the nail into the slot, thereby assisting the user in insertion of the nail into the slot, as per requirement.

[0038]	Simultaneously, the microcontroller in association with an impact sensor embedded in the body 101, detect shocks and vibrations caused during the hammering. The impact sensor used herein is a piece of electronic equipment that detects an impact through vibrations in a manner when the surfaces of the sensor experiences a sudden impact due to a sudden jerk caused during the hammering, the vibrations are imparted which are converted to suitable output signals and sent to the microcontroller in the form of electrical signals. 

[0039]	The microcontroller processes the received signals to detect any shocks and vibrations caused during the hammering and if the detected impact is exceeding a threshold level, then the microcontroller actuates an electromagnetic spring installed in between the handle 102 and body 101 for expanding/contracting to dampen the shocks/vibrations. 

[0040]	The electromagnetic spring operate by using electromagnetic force to control the stiffness or damping characteristics of a spring-like structure. The electromagnetic spring operates using an electromagnetic field to vary the spring's tension. They consist of a coil of wire surrounding a ferromagnetic core, typically attached to a movable component. When an electric current is passed through the coil, the current generates a magnetic field that interacts with the ferromagnetic core, altering its magnetic properties. This changes the overall stiffness or damping of the electromagnetic spring and allowing it to expand/contract for absorbing any shocks experienced during the hammering.

[0041]	During the hammering process, the microcontroller by means of a moisture sensor embedded in the handle 102, detect presence of moisture onto the handle 102. The moisture sensor used herein is a non-contact moisture sensor which operate based on capacitance principle. An electromagnetic field is generated by an oscillator circuit within the sensor. This field extends over the handle 102. When the handle 102 is dry, its dielectric constant is relatively low. However, when moisture is present, the dielectric constant increases. This change in dielectric constant alters the capacitance between the sensor and the surface. The sensor measures the changes in capacitance caused by the presence of moisture. This change is converted into an electrical signal, which is then transferred to the linked microcontroller for interpretation.

[0042]	The microcontroller processes the signals received from the moisture sensor in order to detect presence of moisture onto the handle 102. Based on which the microcontroller actuates an expandable strap 112 to wrap over the user’s wrist for gripping the user’s hand, thus securing the user’s hands on the body 101.

[0043]	In case the user-desired operation corresponds to removal of the nail, the microcontroller actuates multiple motorized hinges 113 (ranging from 2 to 4 in numbers) integrated within the plate 110 to acquire a shape of the nail. The motorized hinge 113 integrates an electric motor with a traditional hinge mechanism to enable controlled, automated rotational movement of the plate 110 around a fixed axis.

[0044]	The hinge joint comprises of a pair of leaf that are screwed with the surface of the adjacent plates 110. The leafs are connected with each other by means of a cylindrical member integrated with a shaft coupled with a DC (Direct Current) motor to provide required movement to the hinge 113. The rotation of the shaft in clockwise and anti-clockwise direction provides required tilting movement to the hinge 113, that in turn tilt the plate 110 in a manner to acquire a shape of the nail.

[0045]	Once the plate 110 is tilted into the shape of nail, the microcontroller actuates a motorized circular slider 114 integrated in between the body 101 and plate 110 for providing rotational movement to the plate 110 for unfastening the nail from the slot. The motorized circular slider 114 consists of a circular track, a motor, and a carriage or platform mounted on the track. The motor, often a stepper or servo motor, drives the carriage around the track using a gear or belt arrangement. By controlling the motor's speed and direction, precise rotational movement of the plate 110 is achieved in order to rotate the plate 110 and unfasten the nail from the slot.

[0046]	Lastly, a battery is installed within the device which is connected to the microcontroller that supplies current to all the electrically powered components that needs an amount of electric power to perform their functions and operation in an efficient manner. The battery utilized here, is generally a dry battery which is made up of Lithium-ion material that gives the device a long-lasting as well as an efficient DC (Direct Current) current which helps every component to function properly in an efficient manner. As the device is battery operated and do not need any electrical voltage for functioning. Hence the presence of battery leads to the portability of the device i.e. user is able to place as well as moves the device from one place to another as per the requirement.

[0047]	The proposed invention works best in the following manner, where the cylindrical body 101 attached with the handle 102 is gripped by the user for positioning the body’s 101 mouth portion in proximity to the drilled slot on the fixed surface. The computing unit is accessed by the user to provide input specifications regarding inserting nails 105 into the slots for the user-desired purpose. Accordingly, the artificial intelligence-based imaging unit 103 paired with the processor determine dimensions of the slot. Further, the motorized clipper 107 acquires the grip of the appropriate nail from the bar 104 configured with multiple nails 105. After which the motorized slider 108 provide required translation to the clipper 107 for positioning the appropriate nail in proximity to mouth portion of the body 101. Further, the telescopically operated rod 109 extend to allow the clipper 107 to engage the gripped nail into the slot. Followed by which the linear actuator 111 positions the plate 110 onto the engaged nail and provide reciprocating back and forth movement to apply the optimum force onto the plate 110 for providing tapping movement to the plate 110 on the nail in view of hammering the nail into the slot for assisting the user in insertion of the nail into the slot as per requirement. Simultaneously, the impact sensor detect shocks and vibrations caused during the hammering. Accordingly, the electromagnetic spring expand/contract to dampen the shocks/vibrations. In case the user-desired operation corresponds to removal of the nail. Multiple motorized hinges 113 tilt the plate 110 to acquire the shape of the nail. Further the motorized circular slider 114 provides rotational movement to the plate 110 in view of unfastening the nail from the slot. 

[0048]	 Although the field of the invention has been described herein with limited reference to specific embodiments, this description is not meant to be construed in a limiting sense. Various modifications of the disclosed embodiments, as well as alternate embodiments of the invention, will become apparent to persons skilled in the art upon reference to the description of the invention.  ,
